_comment: The firm's recurring exhibit set, in display order. Set enabled=false to drop an exhibit without deleting its code. client_safe=false keeps an exhibit out of the client version and makes the build also write an internal version that includes it; use it for any data your firm decides not to show clients (for example a FRED series labelled Copyrighted: Pre-approval required). The valuation pages use roic.ai data, shown to clients by the firm's decision (2026-11-07): the data are not resold. Check your own provider's terms of use before you do the same.
